title: Sam Altman Shows Me GPT 5... And What's Next

scenes.title: ChatGPT prompt typed (with scratch transition)
scenes.what: Cut from Altman through a film-scratch / light-leak overlay into a recreated ChatGPT UI; 'Who is Sam Alt…' types into the prompt box; push-in to the box; scratches + a soft white bloom circle carry back to Cleo.
scenes.motion: UI push-in (ease-out); typed text ~2 chars/frame; 4–6f scratch + bloom transitions
scenes.type: Recreated product UI font (system sans), white on charcoal

scenes.title: Introducing GPT-5 page
scenes.what: Pastel gradient product page; 'GPT-5' gets a lime highlighter; prompt text blurs up from below.
scenes.motion: Push-in + highlight wipe L→R; motion-blurred text slide
scenes.type: Lime highlighter on product UI type

scenes.title: SUPERINTELLIGENCE flash cut
scenes.what: The word 'SUPERINTELLIGENCE' holds dead centre in wide-tracked white heavy caps while the image under it changes every 0.2s (galaxy, MRI, cube, car, piano, lab, robots…). Objects sometimes pass in front of letters.
scenes.motion: Background hard cuts every 5–6 frames on the beat; text stays locked; occasional occlusion
scenes.type: White heavy sans caps, very wide tracking (~+30%), ~6% height, centred

scenes.title: Headline wall + investment chart
scenes.what: Bloom transition from Cleo into news headlines, each with lime highlight on 'superintelligence'; pans across; then a dark chart 'ANNUAL PRIVATE INVESTMENT IN AI' where lines draw up (US, China, Europe); bloom out to Cleo.
scenes.motion: Each headline ~0.4s hard cut with a slight push; chart lines draw L→R
scenes.type: Publisher fonts + lime highlighter; chart: tiny caps labels

scenes.title: HUGE* CONVERSATIONS: SUPERINTELLIGENCE
scenes.what: Show title: stacked HUGE outline/solid rows in colourways, giant cropped H/UGE letters, 'CONVERSATIONS' with outline repeats, then '*SUPERINTELLIGENCE: PART 1' lime on blue.
scenes.motion: 0.2s cuts on the music; letters push through frame
scenes.type: Ultra-heavy grotesque, lime face + dark extrude; outline versions

scenes.title: 'Question from' super
scenes.what: Top-right: circular avatar in lime ring + lime label plates 'QUESTION FROM:' / 'PATRICK COLLISON, STRIPE CEO'.
scenes.motion: Avatar pops, plates wipe on; holds ~14s
scenes.type: Black heavy caps on lime plates, 2 rows

scenes.title: 'Question from' super #2
scenes.what: Same component for Jensen Huang, persists through the wide shot.

scenes.title: End card (sentence-case variant)
scenes.what: Teal panel: coral highlight blocks 'To support Huge If True, please consider subscribing.', lime arrows and 'SUBSCRIBE!'; then sage panel with lime HUGE* + '*if true' and credits on grey label plates.
scenes.type: Coral block highlight with dark humanist sans; lime heavy caps SUBSCRIBE!; credit role labels on grey plates
